title: Research: force all twelve first prelude image lines from main outputs (no new κ)
body:
The proposed variable-prelude search treats the first image line as a free parameter. On the retained round-three scalar chronology and main interfaces, that line is forced for **all twelve operators 47–58**, even after every native warp is cut from the containment graph and all helper/owned boundaries are released.

Each first scalar contact has eight explicit monotone paths to fixed main Y exits. Their independent hyperplane normals have common kernel `<45>`. The fixed nonzero main entrance and invertibility then force the original prelude input and first image line; widening that first input cannot evade the same argument. The certificate checks 96 paths and 996 literal consecutive-contact links separately in each orientation. This is a scoped written proof and finite source certificate, **no new κ, selected-frontier change or supplier admission**.

The scope matters: later prelude contacts and the inverse occurrence can still widen. That changed itinerary is an open construction question; the certificate does not imply a global moment ceiling. See `research/prelude-line-forcing/{README,PROOF}.md` for hypotheses, costs not established and open next questions.

Validation at `bbd5466fab1c799468772eebe0ee8d7d91218d85`: registered ordinary/optimized Python replays pass, seven source/certificate corruptions reject, direct 512-vector kernel evaluation agrees, deterministic certificate regeneration matches, committed-byte/source-history preflight passes, official nine-file export/integrity passes and the unpacked export passes isolated optimized Python. No solver, full selected replay, native phase admission, Lean or independent human review is claimed. Hosted CI plan and registered-package replay both passed at this exact head ([run 39928955486](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39928955486)).

Canonical base `81e9bd69e4a5b00ba9c713a1620e36d576d5522e`, priority revision 7; selected conditional κ remains .00302015. Pre-submission main and 315 open PR bodies were refreshed; the current #5066 operator-47 claim is credited. This source-wide result arose from the complementary operator-48 claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5066#discussioncomment-19141869. Cached historical overlap and arbitrary unpublished/code-diff coverage remain incomplete.

Credit Cao Yifan/intqwq's exact round-three word and joint-map work, Cinna Davis's supplier/controller lineage, Dugongue's transported frames, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, JoyboyBrian/Nick Petalas's extension interface and all retained source contributors.
